newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies tumble 3.00 cent limit.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies tumble 3.00 cent limit.

text.p: July and August CME pork belly futures fell the daily limit of 3.000 cents per lb and other months were off sharply as sell stops were touched off, traders said.
Futures started higher but lacked follow through and turned down sharply on profit taking. Sell stops then took the market down the limit, they said.
E.D. and F. Man was a notable seller in August bellies, traders said.
July was down limit at 78.525 and August off limit at 78.725 cents. February was off 2.450 at 71.050 cents.
